# QEhome Manresa

> QEhome is a two-bedroom holiday apartment in central Manresa (Catalonia, Spain) with a private parking space in the same building, an electric car charger, an equipped kitchen, WiFi, a desk and self check-in. The website is available in Spanish (/es/), Catalan (/ca/) and English (/en/).

Key facts:

- Address: Carrer Doctor Esteve 9, Manresa, Barcelona, Spain
- Phone and WhatsApp: +34 640 95 55 72
- Email: qehomemanresa@gmail.com
- Ratings: 9.7/10 on Booking.com and 4.92/5 on Airbnb
- Check-in from 15:00 (self check-in), check-out before 11:00; no pets
- Parking is included; guests pay separately for the electricity used to charge a vehicle
- Bookings are made through Booking.com or Airbnb; the linked pages below are the authoritative source

## Apartment

- [Home (English)](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/): photos, equipment, practical information, FAQ and booking links
- [Home (Spanish)](https://qehomemanresa.com/es/): Spanish version of the home page
- [Home (Catalan)](https://qehomemanresa.com/ca/): Catalan version of the home page
- [Private parking and EV charger](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/apartamento-parking-manresa/): parking space in the building, access and charging
- [Family apartment](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/apartamento-familias-manresa/): two bedrooms, kitchen and ideas for families

## Stays for a reason

- [Accommodation near UManresa](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/alojamiento-umanresa/): walking times to the university and FGC stations
- [Accommodation near Manresa Hospital](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/alojamiento-hospital-manresa/): about 7 minutes by car from Hospital Sant Joan de Déu (Althaia); not affiliated with the hospital
- [Work stays](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/apartamento-trabajo-manresa/): two separate bedrooms, desk, parking and driving times to industrial estates
- [Ignatian Way accommodation](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/alojamiento-camino-ignaciano-manresa/): arriving in Manresa on the Camino Ignaciano

## Local guides

- [What to see in Manresa](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/que-ver-manresa/): La Seu, the Cave of Saint Ignatius, the old town and a day plan
- [Visiting Montserrat from Manresa](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/visitar-montserrat-desde-manresa/): by car or train, rack railway, cable car and timings
- [Visiting Cardona from Manresa](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/visitar-cardona-desde-manresa/): Salt Mountain mine, castle and collegiate church
- [Pla de Bages wine tourism](https://qehomemanresa.com/en/enoturismo-pla-de-bages/): DO Pla de Bages wineries and wine routes
